ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the bottom-most opening shown in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of the human digestive system. The digestive tract starts from the oral cavity in the head, passes through the esophagus, stomach, and intestines, and finally reaches below the pelvic region. At the very bottom of the figure, a small red terminal opening can be seen, located below the intestines and pointed to by a label line from the lower right. Reasoning: The uppermost opening of the digestive tract is the oral cavity, while the opening at the end of the intestines and at the lowest part of the body is the terminal opening of the digestive system, whose anatomical name is anus.
